text:
Marisol (People Ops): Quick heads-up — Holiday Hub Days are on Dec 18-19 at the SF office. We’re doing two half-days (10:00–15:00) with a small all-hands and holiday lunch both days. RSVP form: https://forms.redwood.example/holiday-hub
Liam (eng): Thanks! Are these mandatory? I’m on call that weekend, might need to skip one day.
Marisol (People Ops): Not mandatory — we know teams have different schedules. Please mark which days you can make so we can plan food and badges.
Sofia (design): Any lodging suggestions for out-of-towners?
Marisol (People Ops): We booked a group block at Harbor Inn (5–10 min from office). Use code REDWOOD2026 by Nov 30 for the discounted rate. Info on the RSVP form.
Dmitri (infra): Shuttle from Caltrain? My team prefers public transit.
Ada (People Ops intern): We’ll run a shuttle from 4th & Mission to the office at 9:15am and 9:45am both days. Return shuttles at 3:30pm and 4:00pm. See schedule below:
GCal Bot: "Event: Holiday Hub Shuttle — Dec 18, 9:15 AM (4th & Mission)
Event: Holiday Hub Shuttle — Dec 18, 9:45 AM (Caltrain Plaza)
Event: Holiday Hub Shuttle — Dec 19, 9:15 AM (4th & Mission)
Event: Holiday Hub Shuttle — Dec 19, 9:45 AM (Caltrain Plaza)"
Liam (eng): Perfect. Will parking be available for folks driving in?
Marisol (People Ops): Limited parking on-site. Please carpool or use public transit where possible. If you absolutely need a spot, email ppl-ops@redwood.ai with your permit request by Dec 8.
Sofia (design): Food allergies — can we indicate dietary restrictions?
Ada (People Ops intern): Yes — the RSVP form has a dietary/allergy checkbox. We’ll label meals (GF, VG, DF, nut-free).
Dmitri (infra): Budget question: do we cover travel for ICs flying in?
Marisol (People Ops): We’ll cover up to $250 for round-trip economy for US domestic flights for headcount under 12hrs travel one-way. Submit receipts through Expensify and tag with "HolidayHub2026". Out-of-country requests: ping me directly.
Liam (eng): Will there be a quiet room for nursing/meditation?
Ada (People Ops intern): Yes — room 302 will be reserved as a flex quiet room both days. Sign-up sheet will be on the office door.
Sofia (design): Can we bring partners for the lunch?
Marisol (People Ops): We can’t cover external guests due to budget, sorry. If you want to bring someone, message ppl-ops and we’ll share guest rates for extra meals.
Dmitri (infra): Any COVID/vax policy updates for the event?
Marisol (People Ops): No new mandates — masks encouraged in common areas if you prefer. If you’re symptomatic, please stay home and we’ll ship a care package to you.
Liam (eng): Thanks, noted. Will there be name badges/wristbands?
Ada (People Ops intern): Yes — check-in at the lobby table, get a badge and a wristband for re-entry.
Marisol (People Ops): Last note: please RSVP by Dec 6 so we can finalize catering and shuttle headcounts. Ping me or @Ada if you need help. :handshake: 
Liam (eng): RSVP done. See you there.
Sofia (design): Done — thanks PMs! :tada:
